recognize_zh: 綠色箭頭標示的中型淋巴樣細胞核圓、染色質均勻，胞質淡藍灰且邊緣呈毛絨狀突起（毛細胞）；藍色箭頭為核偏位、胞質豐富並具核周淡染區的漿細胞；背景紅血球排成錢串狀（rouleaux）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and evenly dispersed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular, fluffy hair-like margins (hairy cells)
Plasma cell with eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin and abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes, a nucleated red cell, and a granulated cell at the edge
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky-type stain, although labeled H&E by the submitter) shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate pale cytoplasm with irregular hair-like projections, consistent with hairy cells. A plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus and abundant basophilic cytoplasm is present nearby. The background shows prominent rouleaux formation, suggesting a serum paraprotein. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia with a coexisting plasma cell population, supporting concurrent plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes of SMZL have short polar villi and more condensed chromatin, and lack CD25, CD123 and annexin A1.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: These cells show a single prominent nucleolus, unlike the hairy cells here with inconspicuous nucleoli.
LPL shows a continuum of small lymphocytes to plasmacytoid cells rather than two separate populations of hairy cells and mature plasma cells.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm rather than round nuclei with circumferential fine projections.
